note: media_iframe provides a single core Media source plugin, inline_frame ('Inline frame'), with allowed_field_types={iframe}. It has no settings form and no configure route (configure=null); everything is done through the standard Media type UI/API. The generated source field defaults to field_media_inline_frame (type iframe, label 'Inline Frame URL') and the media view display is prepared with the iframe_default formatter. Introspection cases create a media type using this source (namespaced source fields field_mi_*) and read back the type/source-field label; execution cases create a media type whose source is inline_frame, verified against the live media type + its source field type. Creating an iframe media type in code requires creating the iframe field storage explicitly before the field, then pointing source_configuration.source_field at it.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal module media_iframe, what is the machine name (id) of the Media source plugin it provides, and what field type must that source's field use?
evals.expected_output: It provides the core Media source plugin id 'inline_frame' (label 'Inline frame'), whose allowed_field_types is {"iframe"} - so its source field is an 'iframe'-type field provided by the contrib iframe module.

evals.prompt: media_iframe has no admin settings page. How do I actually use it to let editors embed iframe URLs as media, and what is the default source field's machine name and label?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route (configure=null). You create a Media type and choose the 'Inline frame' (inline_frame) source; Drupal creates the source field field_media_inline_frame (type iframe, label 'Inline Frame URL') and prepares the view display with the iframe_default formatter.

evals.prompt: Which modules must be installed for media_iframe, and which field formatter does it use to render the iframe on a media type's view display?
evals.expected_output: It depends on core 'media' and the contrib 'iframe' module (which supplies the iframe field type). prepareViewDisplay() renders the source field with the iframe_default formatter and a visually_hidden label.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one media type is backed by the media_iframe 'Inline frame' source. Inspect the live media types and give the machine name of that media type.
evals.expected_output: The media type is mi_probe: its media.type.mi_probe config has source: inline_frame.

evals.prompt: The media type 'mi_lblprobe' on this site uses the media_iframe inline_frame source. Inspect its source field and tell me the human-readable label configured for that source field.
evals.expected_output: The source field (field_mi_lbl, type iframe) has the label 'Inline Frame URL' - the label media_iframe's InlineFrame::createSourceField() applies by default.

evals.prompt: Using the media_iframe module, create a media type with machine name 'mi_task' whose media source is the Inline frame (inline_frame) source, with a working iframe source field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: media.type.mi_task exists with source: inline_frame and source_configuration.source_field pointing at an iframe-type field (e.g. field_media_inline_frame). Create the iframe field storage before the field config, then set the type's source_field.

evals.prompt: I want my editors to be able to paste an embeddable page/URL and manage it in the Media Library like an image. Set up a new media kind (machine name 'mi_task2') that stores an embeddable iframe URL, using the media_iframe module. Make the change on the site.
evals.expected_output: media.type.mi_task2 exists with source: inline_frame and an iframe-type source field. The 'Inline frame' source is what makes the media store an iframe URL and appear in the Media Library.
